arguments.name: e1
arguments.text: Left logical values. Numbers are coerced: zero is false and any other number is true.

arguments.name: e2
arguments.text: Right logical values. Both sides are evaluated.

origin.details: This is R's elementwise & , not a short-circuit test. False combined with a missing value is false. True combined with a missing value is missing.
origin.value: A logical vector of the same length as the longer operand.
